about: Surfing Croyde Bay is a surf centre at Baggy Lodge in Croyde, north Devon, run by a team led by former GB head coach Damon Beveridge. It hires surfboards, wetsuits and bodyboards, booked online, and also runs surf lessons, coasteering, sauna sessions and surf camps.
where: Baggy Lodge, Moor Lane, Croyde EX33 1PA
goodToKnow: Book hire through the online store
Hire includes use of warm changing rooms and hot showers
gaps: Collection point not stated explicitly; no opening hours.
